scope: Six cross-module change paths, including callers, peers and tests. File fingerprints identify evidence, not a new line-by-line audit of every production file. Groups may overlap. Board directories, functions and mixed command arms are excluded.

groups.scenario: Add a tool and inspect an approval retry with a reused call ID.
groups.reason: Keep schema/permission classification, containment decisions and execution as separate owners. Bind UI bodies once through shared occurrence correlation; use absolute request indices for expansion and element state. Approval commands still use the existing protocol call ID.
validation: Reused tagged and legacy IDs retain distinct bodies and pending results; late completion of an old attempt stays attached to it.
Existing approval, denial retry and provider lifecycle tests; full workspace gate.

groups.scenario: Interrupt a queued/running input or a denial retry, then restore its session.
groups.reason: Frame correlation now drives unfinished-occurrence recovery and emits one tagged cancellation per unfinished attempt. Keep environment readiness, durable input delivery, command priority and select-loop ownership. Task children survive a cancelled turn; MoA proposers are pass-scoped.
validation: Real JSONL restart regression for a superseded attempt followed by an unfinished retry and for two unfinished occurrences.
Existing real-daemon crash, drain, replay, input deduplication and cancellation tests pass in the default profile.

groups.scenario: Change result metadata and retrieve the same history through replay, recall and the GUI.
groups.reason: JSONL remains canonical; DuckDB and UI remain projections. Both recall queries share a latest-preceding occurrence-aware result-label join, returning each result once, with the call ID fallback for orphans. Preserve search filtering, order, total-before-limit and bounded text. Replace the observed failing DuckDB window operator with a count over the same filtered CTE.
validation: Recall regression covers reused tagged/legacy IDs, delayed old results, orphan/future requests and totals/order.
The existing DuckDB PhysicalWindow error occurred once during the gate; 120 executions before and 120 after the SQL change did not reproduce it. No claim of a proven flake fix.

groups.scenario: Invoke the same operation by CLI target, active-pane shortcut and UI binding.
groups.reason: The command model owns operations. Keep explicit CLI session targets distinct from the active workspace cursor, and preserve input validation, restore guards, close/detach versus terminate, confirmation and modal focus handling. Small adapters encode meaningful entrypoint differences.
validation: Existing CLI/command/workspace tests and real control-plane tests.
Isolated GUI restart restored two tabs, a two-pane split and the same three terminal sessions.

groups.scenario: Select a plain/MoA model, reload provider settings, or publish a theme to an existing preview.
groups.reason: Share model validation and application with caller-selected catalog generations; move MoA availability wording to its configuration owner. Announce a selection only after command delivery succeeds. Preserve the explicitly accepted current-config hub versus startup-config provider behavior after reload (agent-output-ui-amendment.md, model-picker addendum); do not adopt the separately considered startup-snapshot behavior. Retain startup-only terminal/UI settings and live theme/keybindings/provider reload.
validation: Closed-channel model switch returns an error without changing stored selection or announcing success; regression failed before the fix.
Existing plain/MoA model selection, role override, reload and theme tests.

groups.scenario: Drop a view, lose a connection, reload a runtime or retarget a preview while work is in flight.
groups.reason: Retain per-daemon routes and drain policy, pre-hello retries versus established-connection failure, entity-owned event pumps, attachment generations and preview task cancellation. Terminal input priority, synchronization deadlines and row-generation caching have separate responsibilities. Do not combine lifetimes just because their channel APIs resemble each other.
validation: Existing drop-without-drain, stale-reply cancellation, reconnect classification, PTY and synchronized-update tests.
Isolated Xvfb checks passed marker, Indexed(208), truecolor, OSC 8 and workspace restart. Frame assertions only; no pixel inspection or real IME verification.
